i.norm: Tests the NYSIIS encoder in "true variant" (strict) mode, where encoded strings are capped at a maximum length of 6 characters.
Non-strict NYSIIS encoder that produces encodings of arbitrary length.

Takes an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding. @param testValues an array of String pairs where each pair's first element is the input and the second element the expected encoding.

Verifies that strict-mode NYSIIS (the "true variant") truncates encoded output to at most 6 characters. The name "WESTERLUND" is used as the test input; its full encoding would exceed 6 characters, so strict mode must cap it at "WASTAR".
strict=true enables the original NYSIIS form, which limits output to 6 characters
